data.name: Hannibal
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Phoenician word hannibal, meaning 'graceful' or 'merciful'. The name became famous when the Carthaginian general Hannibal Barca led the Carthaginian army against the Roman Republic in the Second Punic War (218–201 BC).

in_hebrew.name: חננבל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Hannibal is derived from the Hebrew words 'חנן' (chanan) which means grace, and 'אל' (el) which means God. The name Hannibal thus means 'God is gracious' or 'grace from God'.
